# Fajr announcement — rights and migration status

The user-supplied recording named `fajr-user-approved-1.0.103.mp3` did
not have a documented redistribution license. Prior versions included it.
Owner approval does not itself establish recording rights.

**From the next release candidate onward the original MP3 is not bundled
or served.** The foreground browser uses the device's Arabic speech synthesis
for «الصلاة خير من النوم»; the Android service already uses its native
Arabic speech engine. Neither path reproduces or redistributes the unlicensed
recording. Voice quality and available voices depend on the device.

If a human recording is later obtained with written redistribution permission,
retain its attribution and license before restoring it.
